summary: Windows 11 (build 26200), 1.0.67, COM4: five reads 20-110 s each all end in RadioNoResponse; CHIRP ft60 _download received zero bytes every time, so the radio never sent its header. Points to clone mode not entered (F8 CLONE selected without pressing F/W), the cable, or the port rather than timing.
title: Read gets no response from radio (zero bytes) on Windows COM4
